spec_family.name: Exterior Fiber Cement Siding Prime and Paint
spec_family.description: Combined prime and finish coat painting for exterior fiber cement siding (James Hardie HardiePlank, HardieShingle, HardiePanel, and equivalents). Covers full prep (low-pressure wash, scuff sand, end-cut edge seal, caulk siding-to-trim joints), field prime, and finish coats. Three substrate-driven primer paths: acrylic (factory-primed), alkali-resistant/Loxon (bare FC at pH 13.0), bonding (factory-finished ColorPlus). Spray-only finish — NO back-rolling on fiber cement. Uses SF as primary UOM. Siding profile (lap/panel/shingle) and surface texture (smooth/cedarmill/roughsawn) drive rate and material modifiers. Access type drives height modifier. Window/door protection is NOT this spec's responsibility — belongs in window/door specs.

includes: Siding field surface preparation (low-pressure wash, scuff sand per substrate state)
End-sealing ALL field-cut edges (FM-001 prevention — non-negotiable)
Caulking siding-to-trim joints (NOT field butt joints on lap siding)
Full field prime coat (3 substrate-driven primer paths)
Finish coat application (1-2 coats by quality tier)
Interstage inspection, light sand (QT4), and touch-up
Landscape perimeter protection (LF-based along house perimeter)
Fixture and utility masking (light fixtures, HVAC units)

excludes.route_to: Window spec (RC-001 from wood siding: window/door protection owned by surface spec)

excludes.item: Door masking, hardware protection, and glass protection
excludes.route_to: Door spec (RC-001 from wood siding: window/door protection owned by surface spec)

excludes.item: Exterior trim painting (corner boards, frieze, rake, window/door casing)

excludes.route_to: PROHIBITED on fiber cement — strips paint, damages texture, forces water behind wall assembly

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling coat count, inspection scrutiny, interstage sanding, and defect tolerance.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT2=economy (single finish coat). QT3=standard (2 finish coats per Hardie warranty). QT4=premium (2 finish coats, interstage sand, systematic inspection). QT5 excluded for siding field per Exterior_Substrates_Doctrine §5.4.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique for prime and finish coats.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Spray is primary for fiber cement — factory-smooth surface, no back-rolling needed. Brush_roll is fallback for <750 SF, occupied adjacent areas, or high wind. spray_backroll is NOT valid for this spec — back-rolling introduces unwanted stipple/orange peel on fiber cement.

configuration_dimensions.description: Siding profile type. Drives production rate modifier (FAC_FCSD_SIDING_PROFILE).
configuration_dimensions.notes: Lap is baseline (long horizontal runs). Panel slightly slower. Shingle is dramatically slower (many edges, complex geometry, constant repositioning).

configuration_dimensions.description: Surface texture. Drives production rate AND material quantity modifier (FAC_FCSD_SURFACE_TEXTURE).
configuration_dimensions.notes: Textured profiles trap more paint in valleys, requiring additional spray passes for correct DFT. Affects both production rate and material consumption.

configuration_dimensions.description: Substrate condition at time of painting. Drives primer selection and prep task activation.
configuration_dimensions.notes: SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY is the dominant NC state. SS_EXT_BARE_FIBERCEMENT requires alkali-resistant primer. SS_EXT_FACTORY_FINISHED requires bonding primer. SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD skips prime entirely.

paintable_items.name: Siding Field
paintable_items.counting_rules: Net paintable siding field area in square feet. Excludes window/door openings, trim boards. Measured per elevation.
paintable_items.notes: Primary and only paintable item. Reused from SF_WOOD_SIDING_EXT_NC_PAINT — same physical item, different substrate material. Profile and texture modifiers adjust effective production rates.

variants.notes: Economy spray on lap siding. Single finish coat. Full landscape/hardscape protection for overspray.
Standard spray production on lap siding. Two finish coats per Hardie warranty. Full protection.
Standard brush/roll on lap siding. Reduced protection scope — no full landscape or patio cover needed.
Premium spray on lap siding. Interstage sanding. Systematic inspection at 6 ft. Premium materials.
Standard spray on panel siding. 1.10x profile modifier on application tasks.
Standard spray on shingle siding. 2.00x profile modifier. Dramatically slower production. 413 spray tip for complex geometry.
Economy spray on field-primed surface. Skip prime. Single finish coat. Minimum viable scope.
Standard spray on field-primed surface. Skip prime. Two finish coats.

protection_zones_required.notes: LF-based — measured along house perimeter where landscape is adjacent. Brush/roll: drop cloth at base. Spray: full tarp width over plantings.
Walkways adjacent to siding. Canvas drop cloths for non-slip crew traffic.
Patio adjacent to siding. Protection level driven by proximity and application method.
All exterior fixtures on working elevations. Bag or tape over fixture.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Soffit at eave line. Different color typically. Separate scope.
Frieze board at siding-to-soffit junction. Trim color. Separate scope.
Corner boards frame siding. Trim color. Siding terminates at corner.
Window casing. Siding terminates at casing. Window/door protection is window/door spec's responsibility.
Door casing. Same as window casing relationship.
Foundation below siding. Not painted in siding scope.

valid_input_states.notes: Four NC-relevant substrate states. SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY is the dominant state (factory-primed fiber cement as delivered). SS_EXT_BARE_FIBERCEMENT at cut edges and damaged areas — requires alkali-resistant primer for pH 13.0. SS_EXT_FACTORY_FINISHED for ColorPlus/ExpertFinish damaged during construction — requires bonding primer. SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD for split-mobilization scenarios where prime was applied separately.

output_state.notes: Output state varies by sheen configuration. Satin is the most common exterior siding sheen.

site_condition_rules.affected_tasks: All tasks performed at elevation (see FAC_EXT_ACCESS applies_to list in production.json)
site_condition_rules.effect: ground=1.00, ladder=1.35, scaffold=1.60, lift=1.50. Applied as time multiplier: effective_rate = base_rate / modifier.
site_condition_rules.notes: Access type is a height modifier (like FAC_HEIGHT for interior), NOT a site condition. Applied per elevation.

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Setup → Prep → Prime → Finish 1 → Interstage → Finish 2 → Final Inspect → Cleanup
sequencing_notes.edge_work: No edge work in this spec. Siding terminates at trim boards — no cut-in or blending across specs.
sequencing_notes.protection_sequence: Landscape/hardscape protection → Fixture masking → Equipment setup → Coating work → Protection teardown → Equipment cleanup → Site cleanup
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence: Prep (substrate-state-driven) → Prime (1 coat, skipped for SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD) → Finish coat 1 → Interstage (inspect, sand QT4, touch up) → Finish coat 2 (QT3/QT4) → Final inspect → Touch up
sequencing_notes.elevation_strategy: Work one elevation at a time to minimize protection setup/teardown cycles. Follow shade for optimal conditions.
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO back-rolling on fiber cement. NO high-pressure power washing. NO caulking field butt joints on lap siding.

relationships.cross_spec_protection_note: Window/door protection during siding work is owned by window/door specs, not this spec. If windows/doors are in scope, their specs handle glass/hardware masking.
relationships.notes: Second exterior siding spec. Shares ITM_SIDING_FIELD and many protection zones with wood siding sibling. Key departures: no back-rolling, alkali-resistant primer path, bonding primer path, end-cut edge sealer, no power washing.

sections_used: No back-rolling on fiber cement Part A §6

research_corrections.original_claim: ColorPlus and ExpertFinish factory-finished products are OUT OF SCOPE for this NC painting spec
research_corrections.corrected_to: Factory-finished fiber cement is IN SCOPE as SS_EXT_FACTORY_FINISHED. Post-construction damage commonly requires field prime (bonding primer) + paint.
SW Loxon Masonry Primer identified as the reference product for bare fiber cement (pH 13.0).

user_corrections.original: SF-based landscape protection (ext_landscape_adjacent SF + ext_landscape_full SF)
user_corrections.corrected_to: LF-based landscape perimeter protection (ext_landscape_perimeter LF). You measure the run along the house, not the area of landscape beds.

user_corrections.original: FAC_EXT_SUBSTRATE_CONDITION modifier with values SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY, SS_EXT_BARE_FIBERCEMENT, SS_EXT_FACTORY_FINISHED, SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD
user_corrections.corrected_to: Removed FAC_EXT_SUBSTRATE_CONDITION entirely. Those are substrate STATES (what it is), not CONDITIONS (good/poor/failing). NC has no meaningful condition variation. State routing handled by substrate_state_rules in sop_modules.json.

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for exterior fiber cement siding prime and paint. Second exterior siding spec — follows SF_WOOD_SIDING_EXT_NC_PAINT_v1 pattern with fiber cement-specific departures. Key features: combined prime+paint (single mobilization), 4 NC substrate states (factory-primed, bare FC, factory-finished, field-primed), 3 siding profiles (lap/panel/shingle), 3 surface textures (smooth/cedarmill/roughsawn), 2 application methods (spray/brush_roll — no back-rolling), 3 quality tiers (QT2-QT4, QT5 excluded), 25 tasks across 8 modules, 3 primer systems (acrylic/alkali-resistant/bonding), 2 finish systems (standard/premium), 3 factor modifiers (access/profile/texture). 2 research corrections + 2 user corrections applied. QA result: pass_with_warnings (2 minor issues, 1 resolved, 1 acknowledged).
